_about: What each measure column IS, read from the parts of its name (audit 2026-10-29, section G). One list for the backend (app/measure_kinds.py) and the frontend (frontend/src/chat/measureKinds.js, a copy checked by tests/test_chat_ui_audit_totals_2026_10_29.py). rate: never added; stock: added across places only; distinct: added across places only (the same village / household repeats across years and schemes); flow: added across places and years. Nothing is added across schemes. Checked in this order: rate, stock, flow, distinct; anything else is a flow.
